statement: The function returns a result r, and r = sum_abs(matrix) if neg_count(matrix) is even, while r = sum_abs(matrix) - 2 * min_abs(matrix) if neg_count(matrix) is odd. Here sum_abs(matrix) is the sum of |matrix[i][j]| over all 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n; neg_count(matrix) is the number of pairs (i,j) with matrix[i][j] < 0; min_abs(matrix) is the minimum of |matrix[i][j]| over all 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n.
preconditions: Let n = len(matrix). The input satisfies 2 <= n <= 250, len(matrix[i]) = n for every 0 <= i < n, and -100000 <= matrix[i][j] <= 100000 for every 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n.
